{{Top|leg}}
'''Panelman''' was [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] slang for a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served as the [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]] to another TIE fighter while on a mission or exercise. The term was derived from the characteristic wing panels of the TIE/LN [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].

==Behind the scenes==
The term is apparently a modification of the modern military term [[Wikipedia:wingman|wingman]], which describes an aircraft flying beside and slightly behind the lead plane in a formation.
